## Submit your wallpaper

1. **Drag your wallpaper file into this text box** (image, GIF, or MP4 — GitHub will upload it and insert a link).
2. Give it a name:

**Wallpaper name:**

**Type:** still / live

3. Confirm both of these by leaving the checkboxes ticked:

- [x] I made this wallpaper myself, or it is free to redistribute (no copyrighted images, logos, characters, or other people's work)
- [x] It contains nothing inappropriate (no NSFW, gore, hate content, or personal information)

Submissions are reviewed before they appear in the app. Anything that doesn't
meet the rules above is declined.
